name: Scan-line Clipping Algorithm
definition: A 3D generalization of a scan-line algorithm adjusted for low-level processor implementation to determine which portions of a room are not obscured by higher priority rooms or figurines.
summary: The Scan-line Clipping Algorithm is a 3D generalization of the classic scan-line method that processes volumetric primitives scan-by-scan to write only visible segments to the Compositing Frame Buffer, ensuring higher-priority data is never overwritten.
